cross_table.layer_recognize_kinds_note: Reference list into enums.routing_trace_kind. Members must be subset. Includes layer_propose, layer_ask_subset, layer_formal_review, layer_propose_slice, layer_merge_layers.

error_code_boundaries.cross_table_contract_invalid: Missing or illegal contract keys/values (including batch2/batch3 schema/enum keys; plan_regenerate_max missing/non-positive/non-int; structure_status/stage_rollback_point enum missing).
error_code_boundaries.cross_table_audit_structure_invalid: Trace metadata fails audit primary-key rules: missing run_id; missing trigger_source; call_kind not in allowed set; block_id normalize collision within same run; decision_params shape violation. code string MUST be cross_table_audit_structure_invalid (standalone); do not wrap as cross_table_contract_invalid. Do not write trace storage.
error_code_boundaries.trace_io_failed: trace_dir / trace_filename_pattern missing or illegal; filesystem IO; empty file.

trace_filename_placeholders.kind: Equals call_kind / node kind literal from routing_trace_kind
trace_filename_placeholders.note: Quintuple lives in JSON meta only; not required filename placeholders.

block_id.note: Normalize int/string to string before store. Within one run_id, if two distinct raw block_ids normalize to the same string, raise cross_table_audit_structure_invalid (collision).

block_id_raw.description: Optional original value before normalize; for collision diagnostics

call_kind.note: Must be member of layer_recognize_kinds (subset of routing_trace_kind)

block_id_normalize_rules.normalize: str(raw) with no extra padding; bool rejected
block_id_normalize_rules.collision: Same run_id + two different raw ids -> same normalized string => cross_table_audit_structure_invalid; do not write

ask_usage_after.description: Real consumed counts after this call (proposal/subset/review).

prompt_hash.description: sha256(prompt) hex digest first 16 lowercase chars

dimensions.description: Total dimension field ids across dimensions_by_subtable

prompt_full.description: Full or truncated prompt; truncation uses MARKER and layer_recognize_trace_raw_max_chars

raw_full.description: Model raw (object when dict and not truncated) or string; never null. Exception path uses <prefix>_exception:<Type>: msg

raw_chars.description: Pre-truncation len(json.dumps(raw, ensure_ascii=False)) or len(exception string)

validate_reasons.description: See CONTRACT_CHANGE_TRACE_AUDIT.md §5; empty reasons with ok=false must fall back to validate_false_with_empty_reasons

LayerRecognizeTraceBody.serialization_note: Length, truncation, body assembly, and write_trace disk write MUST use ensure_ascii=False.
LayerRecognizeTraceBody.truncation_note: MARKER = newline + /* truncated */; MAX = layer_recognize_trace_raw_max_chars; disk form S[:MAX-len(MARKER)]+MARKER with len==MAX.
LayerRecognizeTraceBody.exception_chaining_note: When business and trace errors coexist: raise business from trace_exc (business is primary; trace is __cause__). Never rely on __context__ alone.

decision_params_rules.reasoned_requires: rationale_text non-empty string from user/model only
invalid_cases: mechanical decision with non-empty rationale_text => cross_table_audit_structure_invalid
reasoned decision with only {mechanical: true} => cross_table_audit_structure_invalid
rationale_text non-empty AND mechanical true simultaneously => cross_table_audit_structure_invalid

input_block_ids.note: Optional in batch2. Hook for subsequent-12 S contract: when S triggers cross-block ownership rollback (point 4), the trace MUST carry input_block_ids; otherwise S-side structure invalid.

StageExecTraceMeta.subsequent_12_hook: S contract (后续-12) must require input_block_ids when S triggers 跨块归属④ rollback; missing => S structure invalid. Batch2 only reserves the optional field + this hook.

StagePlanSchema.description: Formal stage plan shape for B output / S input. Authority after batch3 landing; formerly B_CONTRACT section 3. Per-stage allow_user_ask (boolean) is a permission ceiling: whether S may trigger E when stage review fails. StageReviewResult.needs_user_ask (boolean) is the review-side judgment for this attempt. S triggers E only when allow_user_ask AND needs_user_ask are both true. These two fields are different concepts; do not conflate.

review_result.description: Review judgment object; shape aligns with StageReviewResult (needs_user_ask = this-attempt judgment, not the stage permission allow_user_ask).

needs_user_ask.description: Review-side judgment for this attempt. S triggers E only if stage allow_user_ask AND this needs_user_ask.

row_range.description: Row locator range; may declare whole table.

col_range.description: Column locator range; may declare whole table.

items.description: Must be member of cross_table.enums.orchestrate_decision_kind (direct membership; no second enum).

allowed_decision_kinds.note: Each element must be in enums.orchestrate_decision_kind.

allow_user_ask.description: Stage permission ceiling: whether S may trigger E when stage review fails. Distinct from StageReviewResult.needs_user_ask (review judgment). S triggers E only when allow_user_ask AND needs_user_ask.

rollback_point.description: Must be member of enums.stage_rollback_point (figure-4 points 1-3 only). cross_block_ownership (point 4) MUST NOT appear in a stage declaration; reject at plan validation.

dependency_allows_prior.description: Whether prior stage products may influence this stage.

validation_notes.rollback_point_four_forbidden: Plan instance with rollback_point equal to cross_block_ownership (or any value outside stage_rollback_point) must be rejected at plan validation time, not at schema-load time.
validation_notes.authority: After landing, this Schema is authoritative; B_CONTRACT section 3 is marked as carried by Schema.

empty_text_ratio.description: Must be 1.0 when sample_texts is empty

notes.ProposeSliceWindowRules: order: sort rectangles by (locator.r0, locator.c0, locator.r1, locator.c1, rect_id). packing: greedy grow window; estimate chars via same serializer as propose; if adding rect exceeds layer_recognize_propose_input_max_chars: close window if non-empty else conflict propose_single_rect_over_capacity. filter_facts: relation in propose_slice_relation_keep and both ends in window. cell_texts: full texts for window rects (no sampling). slice_count derived; never fixed.
notes.MergeLayerSampleTextsRules: Per local layer_id: geometric-order first 3 rects; each first-row text; dedupe; truncate each item to 200 chars. If empty: fallback first non-empty cell per rect; if still empty: sample_texts=[] and empty_text_ratio=1.0. Non-empty layers must not set empty_text_ratio=1.0. Slice propose cell_texts never truncated.
notes.MergeHeaderBandTextsRules: Header-band rects: kind==group_label OR locator.r0==min r0 in slice. header_band_texts[rect_id]=readable attached text. No header-band => {}.
notes.MergeInputTrimPriority: When merge input > review_input_capacity: (1) shrink cell_texts_boundary to ends of cross_slice_contains_candidates only (never {}); (2) per-slice header_band_texts keep first 3 geometric; (3) each layer sample_texts shrink to 1; (4) still over => conflict cross_slice_merge_input_over_capacity, no merge call. Forbidden: drop layer_summaries layer count; empty cross_slice_contains_candidates; cell_texts_boundary={}.
notes.HeaderCompletenessMergePolicy: Authoritative header_completeness only from LayerRecognizeMergeResult. Must use header_band_texts. Forbid any(slice complete)=>block complete. incomplete/not_header => review_failed (后患1).
Authoritative header_completeness only from LayerRecognizeMergeResult. Must use header_band_texts. Forbid any(slice complete)=>block complete. incomplete/not_header => review_failed (后患1).
notes.merge_no_retry: Merge failure / overall_sanity fail / structure invalid: no retry.
